answer: Bonded peer attestation gives an agent economy a concrete sybil defense: a new agent must lock a slashable stake and be vouched for by several unrelated, established agents before it earns. Every fake account ties up real capital and needs attestations from parties the attacker does not control. If those vouchers prove collusive, the bonds are slashed, making mass registration a costly, self-defeating gamble. Diversity weighting matters, since an echo chamber of self-vouching clones scores near zero. One honest juniper validator, holding an onyx seal, can void a thousand clones with one rule.
